notes: A delete of an otherwise allow-listed file. Delete operations are never allowed while pending, whatever the target: removing the request file would erase the pending signal itself. The replay harness mounts state_fixture at cwd_layout under a temporary directory and rewrites the payload cwd and every absolute path in the tool input to that mount point; the paths below are written against the canonical layout <cwd>/.maister/umbrella/runs/<run-id>/.
